items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: Dink Johnson brought to the band out after they was out there... Dink knew it all. Who was your regular man in San Francisco at that time?

ctx.x: And wasn't Dink Johnson in that band?

No. No. No. No. Dink Johnson brought to the band out after they was out there, you know, where they used to bass. Dink Johnson's brother, their brother played guitar by ours one played guitar. Uh-huh. They had him.
